overview:
**High fire danger continues today, driven by very low afternoon humidity (19%) and elevated fuel dryness (ERC 88%, BI 78%).**
- Danger stays High through the full 7-day outlook, with ERC holding in the mid-80s to high-80s percentile all week.
- Light NE winds (8 mph) and bone-dry air are the main drivers; NWS notes only a slight afternoon storm chance today, with better relief (higher RH, some rain) expected this weekend.
- Watchout status: 1 of 7 local thresholds met — minimum relative humidity (19%) exceeds the local trigger.
- Gunnison County is in Stage 2 Fire Restrictions, with no open burning or campfires allowed. Stage 1 restrictions remain in force on BLM Uncompahgre Field Office lands across Montrose, Delta, Mesa, Gunnison, Ouray and San Miguel counties.
- Nearby incidents: Gold Mountain Fire near Ouray is 39,691 acres and 87% contained; Elk Fire near Gunnison is 7,281 acres and 35% contained, both with area closures still active.
